lessons.title: Scale Drawing

explanation_sections.title: Scale Drawing
explanation_sections.body:
A scale drawing represents real distances using a consistent ratio. A scale of 1:50,000 means 1 cm on
the map represents 50,000 cm or 500 m on the ground.

lessons.source_reference: ElimuQuest Mathematics Curriculum Draft v1, PDF p. 14
lessons.author: ElimuQuest

questions.prompt: On a 1:100,000 map, two towns are 6 cm apart. Find the actual distance in kilometres.
A room is 8 m long. How long is it on a 1:100 drawing?
A road is 12 cm on a 1:25,000 map. Find actual distance in kilometres.
Why must units be compatible before using a scale?
